text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle thoroughly enjoyed her Make 
Debut race, offering a glimpse of her 
immense talent for sprints and miles.

However... aiming for "Umamusume of the 
Year" solely through Sprint and Mile races 
is bound to be a treacherous path...

However, seeing Taiki Shuttle's powerful 
run, the Trainer believed that she could 
perform miracles—

She decided to enter the winter mile race, 
the Shinzan Kinen!
